summary: Iteration 79 — All three fixes verified. BACKEND: 5/5 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration79_budget_wealth.py pass against POST /api/notifications/evaluate-budget. (a) spent==budget (100/100) → notification title 'Budget fully used' with body containing 'right on budget' and NO 'over budget' wording; (b) spent>budget (101/100) → title 'Budget exceeded' with body containing '$1.00' over amount; (c) 0.01 tolerance boundary: spent=100.01 vs budget=100 → 'Budget exceeded' (penny-over still counts); (d) spent<80% → no alert emitted; (e) evaluate-budget premium-gate regression: unpaid alex+test1 receives HTTP 402 with detail.error='payment_required' and detail.subscription_status present. FRONTEND (Expo web preview, 390×844): logged in as demo@jaleter.com premium. (1) Wealth strip renders TOTAL CASH / SET ASIDE / AVAILABLE and the equation Available = Total − SetAside holds ($0 − $100 = −$100, 'Over-allocated' label appears). (2) Added a new Set Aside bucket of $100 via nw-restricted → bucket-add → bucket-name + bucket-amount + bucket-save; strip updates to Total=$0, SetAside=$100, Available=−$100. (3) Navigated to Legacy → BUILD 1yr; the AVAILABLE CASH chip in YOUR ASSUMPTIONS shows −$100, matching Wealth's Available (would have shown $0 = Total Cash before the fix). Fix #4 confirmed. (4) Bumped the same bucket by another $100 (bucket-add-<id> → bucket-tx-amt=100 → bucket-tx-save); Wealth Available becomes −$200 and Legacy AVAILABLE CASH chip live-updates to −$200. Fix #5 confirmed. (5) Regression on sheets (KeyboardAwareScrollView refactor): opened Budget 'tap to set' via budget-sub-<id> (budget-edit-amount input visible), Transaction add via tx-add (tx-amount input visible), Legacy hypothetical via legacy-chip-hypo (sheet opened), Set Aside sheet (bucket-name input visible) — all open/scroll/close normally. (6) All 6 bottom-nav tabs (nav-home, nav-budget, nav-reports, nav-transactions, nav-networth, nav-legacy) render without red screen and without PAGEERROR. Only console noise = expo-notifications 'web listener' warning + 'shadow* deprecated' RN warning + a transient 'Disconnected from Metro (1006)' dev-server reconnect — none are user-facing. Budget exact-match 100%/OVER badge was not visually reproducible because the demo user's default budget is $0 across all subcategories (no data to spend against), but (i) the code at /app/frontend/src/screens/BudgetScreen.tsx:996 (barColor = pct>100 ? red : pct>=80 ? amber : green) and :1035-1041 (alertLevel: exceeded ONLY when spct>100, 'full'/'100%' amber when spct>=100 but not >100, plus leftColor: remaining<0 ? red : remaining<b*0.2 ? amber : green — so exact match gives amber not red) implements the exact-match spec, and (ii) the backend evaluator applies the identical convention with a 0.005 tolerance (verified). Fix #3 confirmed via code + backend behavior parity.
critical_code_review_comments: BudgetScreen.tsx:996 barColor uses strict > for red: `pct > 100 ? C.red : pct >= 80 ? C.amber : C.green` — exactly 100% correctly falls into the amber branch, not red. Left-column color at :1042 mirrors the fix: `remaining < 0 ? C.red : remaining < b*0.2 ? C.amber : green` — exact match → remaining=0 → amber ($0 in amber, not red).

BudgetScreen.tsx:1033-1041 alertLevel priority is correct: 'exceeded' ONLY when spct>100; 'full' (badge label '100%') when spct>=100 && !>100; 'p80' when >=80; 'p50' when >=50. Badge text at :1057 maps 'full' → '100%' and 'exceeded' → 'OVER'.

LegacyScreen.tsx:100 buildStartingCash = availableCash (falls back to totalCash only when availableCash is not a number). LegacyScreen is passed `availableCash` from app/index.tsx:1026 which computes `totalCash − totalRestricted`. AVAILABLE CASH chip at :431 and Row 'Cash (from Wealth)' at :649 both use buildStartingCash. Fix propagates correctly.
HomeScreen.tsx also receives `availableCash` prop from app/index.tsx:986 and mirrors LegacyScreen so the Home projections agree with the BUILD chip.

backend/budget_alert_service.py:158-166 uses `over = spent - budget; if over > 0.005 → Budget exceeded else Budget fully used`. Tolerance ($0.005) correctly handles float-round noise around $100.00, and $100.01 still trips the 'exceeded' branch (verified). Body copy for 'fully used' says 'right on budget' — matches spec, no 'over budget' language leaks.
notifications_router.py:194 evaluate-budget dependency `_member_auth()` correctly returns 402 for unpaid users while premium/admin pass through — verified end-to-end.

app/index.tsx:714-718 totalRestricted = sum of non-archived buckets; availableCash = totalCash − totalRestricted. Both are React.useMemo dependencies for downstream consumers, so a bucket edit propagates through LegacyScreen and HomeScreen on the next render (verified via live-update test).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration79_budget_wealth.py -v (5 tests, ~2s). Every evaluate-budget test uses a unique per-run period ('TEST-<uuid>') and sub_id ('TEST_iter79_*_<uuid>') to bypass server-side alert_state dedup — DO NOT reuse fixed period/sub_id or the second run will return `created:[]`. Adding another $1 tx flips it to red 'OVER'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — main-agent fixes are behavior-correct at the API + component level. Bug (3) resolved via strict-`>` comparisons in BudgetScreen barColor/alertLevel/leftColor and 0.005 tolerance in budget_alert_service. Bug (4) resolved by threading `availableCash` (=totalCash−totalRestricted) into LegacyScreen and HomeScreen instead of totalCash — buildStartingCash now correctly uses the available number, and the chip label 'AVAILABLE CASH' at LegacyScreen.tsx:431 matches. Bug (5) is a side-effect of the same availableCash memoization in app/index.tsx: any bucket mutation triggers a totalRestricted recompute → new availableCash → LegacyScreen rerenders with the new value; verified by round-tripping bucket amount from $100 → $200.
